items.title: Semafor: ‘Hours Before Huang’s Reinstatement, Trump Called Nvidia’s Board to Argue for His Return’
items.brief_zh: 据 Semafor 的知情人士说，Trump 在 Nvidia 董事会开会时打电话，力主让 Jensen Huang 回任，几小时后董事会就宣布了复职。
items.background_zh: Nvidia 董事会主席 Harvey Jones 在六天前的财报电话会上还表示，董事会已一致接受 Huang 的辞职，不打算让他复任 CEO。复职的反转如此突然，所以外界关注是谁在背后推动。
items.conclusion_zh: 文章没有另外的结论。Gruber 最后用一句讽刺的话收尾，指 Jones 需要有人帮他找回裤子。
items.brief_en: Semafor reports that Trump called Nvidia's board to argue for Jensen Huang's return. The board reinstated Huang hours later.
items.background_en: Six days earlier, the board chairman had said on an earnings call that the board would not bring Huang back as CEO. The quick reversal is why the role of outside pressure is the main question here.
items.conclusion_en: The post does not state a further conclusion. Gruber ends with a joke about Jones needing help finding his pants.
points_zh: Semafor 的消息来源称，Trump 在 Nvidia 董事会的紧急会议中拨入电话，支持 Huang 回任，时间是复职宣布前几个小时。白宫传播事务主任 Steven Cheung 表示，Trump 全程参与，并称这是一个很好的决定。
董事会主席 Harvey Jones 发表声明，认为 Huang 是领导 Nvidia 的合适人选，复职符合股东、员工、合作伙伴和客户的利益。Gruber 指出，这与 Jones 在财报电话会上的说法正好相反。
Gruber 认为，一直主张政府不应干预企业事务的共和党人，如果支持 Trump 这样为人事决定施压，就是前后不一。他说，同样的事如果换成 Newsom 或 Ossoff 去做，这些人也不会支持。
points_en: Semafor's sources say Trump dialed into the Nvidia board meeting to argue for Huang's return. The call came hours before the reinstatement. White House communications director Steven Cheung said Trump was 'totally involved' and called the decision a good one.

Board chairman Harvey Jones said Huang is the right person to lead Nvidia and that his return serves shareholders, employees, partners and customers. Gruber notes that Jones had said the opposite on the earnings call six days earlier.

Gruber argues that Republicans who oppose government involvement in business would be inconsistent to support Trump's call. He says they would not support the same move by Democrats such as Gavin Newsom or Jon Ossoff.

items.title: Government Regulation and Demand
items.brief_zh: Ben Thompson 认为，技术生态需要真实的需求来推动，光靠政府投入不够。Gruber 同意这个看法，并认为欧盟的做法让本土替代品既出不来，用户又用不到更好的版本。
items.background_zh: 作者上周转发过 Ben Thompson 谈 Nvidia 和 Jensen Huang 的文章。这篇文章讨论的是其中一段关于政府政策与需求的论述，作者认为这段论述很有道理。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，技术替代品要靠真实的使用需求才能成长，光有愿望不够。只要外国平台还容易使用，本土竞争者就拿不到它需要的需求。
items.brief_en: Gruber agrees with Ben Thompson that homegrown tech needs real demand, not just government backing. He says the EU approach gives it neither alternatives nor better versions of the platforms.
items.background_en: Gruber had linked to a column by Ben Thompson on Nvidia and Jensen Huang the week before. This post looks at one passage in that column about government policy and demand.
items.conclusion_en: Alternatives grow only when people use them. As long as foreign platforms stay easy to use, local rivals do not get the demand they need.
points_zh: Thompson 认为，中国政府只能通过投资和自上而下的指令推动供给，但建立技术生态还需要需求。模型和芯片的进步依赖用户与开发者之间的反馈循环，而需求方通常比政府更看重短期。他还说，模型公司会互相跟随，别人蒸馏，它也蒸馏；别人用 Nvidia 芯片，它也用。
Thompson 用防火长城做类比。中国切断了美国科技公司的服务，才逼出了本土科技巨头。他认为，中国禁止进口 Nvidia 的 H20 芯片，也是在重演同样的做法，让国内需求被迫转向较弱的替代品，替代品只有这样才会变好。
Gruber 同意这一观点，并以欧盟为例。他说，如果欧盟真想要 Facebook、Google 搜索和 iOS 的本土替代品，就该像中国那样封禁这些平台。实际上，欧盟允许这些平台运营，却要求它们删减功能，结果欧盟既得不到替代品，公民用到的也是功能更少的版本。
points_en: Thompson argues that China's government can only push the supply side through money and top-down orders. Building an ecosystem also needs demand, and progress in models and chips depends on a feedback loop between users and developers. Model companies follow each other, so if one distills or uses Nvidia chips, the others do too.

Thompson compares this to the Great Firewall. By cutting off American tech companies, China created the demand that grew its own tech giants. He says China's ban on imports of Nvidia's H20 chip follows the same playbook, forcing domestic demand onto weaker alternatives.

Gruber agrees and uses the EU as an example. If the EU wanted homegrown alternatives to Facebook, Google search and iOS, it would need to ban them, as China does. Instead, the EU lets these platforms run while forcing them to remove features. Gruber says this leaves the EU without alternatives and gives its citizens worse versions of the platforms.

items.title: Elon Musk Claims to Be Unfamiliar With MAGA
items.brief_zh: Musk 在共和党中期选举大败后表示，他不确定 MAGA 是什么意思，并对自己在选举上的巨额花费感到“很愚蠢”。Gruber 认为，这些说法与 Musk 过去公开支持 MAGA 的言行明显不符。
items.background_zh: 共和党在中期选举中大败。Musk 是特斯拉和 SpaceX 的 CEO，也是这次选举中个人捐款最多的人。
items.conclusion_zh: 文章没有另外的结论。Gruber 认为，多数商界高管都不会站得离政治太近，而 Musk 在这方面已经走得很远。
items.brief_en: Musk says he is not sure what MAGA means and feels foolish about his midterm spending. Gruber says those claims do not match Musk's earlier public support for MAGA.
items.background_en: The Republicans lost badly in the midterm elections. Musk, who runs Tesla and SpaceX, was the top individual donor in the election.
items.conclusion_en: The post does not add a further conclusion. Gruber says most executives keep a short distance from politics, and Musk has gone much further than that.
points_zh: Musk 说他不确定 MAGA 指的是什么，并表示如果它指的是对共和党政策的盲目服从，那他并不是这样的人。这段话出自 USA Today 专栏作者 Rex Huppke 的文章。
Musk 表示，他对花在中期选举上的巨额资金感到很愚蠢。据报道，他捐出 4.46 亿美元支持共和党，主要是在他的公司大多所在的德州。他是这届选举中个人捐款最多的人。
Gruber 列出 Musk 过去的言行：他戴过 MAGA 帽子，在 Trump 的集会上发言，并在 2024 年自称是“dark MAGA”。Gruber 认为，这与他现在说的不了解 MAGA 对不上。
points_en: Musk says he is not sure what MAGA means. He adds that he does not follow Republican Party policies blindly.
Musk says he feels pretty foolish about the record sum he spent on the midterms. He gave $446m to support the Republican Party, mostly in Texas, where many of his companies are based.

Gruber lists Musk's earlier ties to MAGA. Musk wore a MAGA hat, spoke at Trump rallies and in 2024 called himself 'dark MAGA'. Gruber says this does not fit with Musk now saying he is unfamiliar with the movement.

items.title: Nvidia Board Reinstates Jensen Huang
items.brief_zh: Nvidia 宣布 Jensen Huang 即日起复任 President 和 CEO，并重新担任董事。董事会表示，在听取美国政府高层意见后，认为他的复职不存在国家安全风险。
items.background_zh: Huang 之前被移出 CEO 职位，现在董事会撤销了这一决定。Gruber 还提到，NYT 在复职前一个周末报道称，Alice Huang 一年多来一直与中国国家安全部（MSS）的一名官员保持定期联系，直到今年秋天；原文没有说明她与 Jensen Huang 是否有关系。
items.conclusion_zh: Gruber 承认，这次科技界的判断比政界更准确，他自己也判断错了。他认为，原因可能是 AI 和风投圈对 Trump 政府还剩多少政治资本，以及它愿不愿意动用，判断得更清楚。
items.brief_en: Nvidia reinstated Jensen Huang as President and CEO with immediate effect. The board says his return poses no national security risk.
items.background_en: Huang had been removed as CEO, and the board has now reversed that decision. Gruber also cites a New York Times report from the weekend before, about Alice Huang's contact with a Chinese MSS official, though the post does not link her to Huang.
items.conclusion_en: Gruber admits that the tech side read the situation better than the political side, and that he was wrong. He suggests the AI and venture capital circles may have had a clearer sense of how much political capital the Trump administration had left and how willing it was to use it.
points_zh: Nvidia 宣布 Huang 即日起复任 President 和 CEO，并重新担任董事会成员。董事会一致投票通过，此前与他多次讨论和会面，最后对他的坦诚和领导能力感到满意。
董事会表示，在作出决定的过程中，它收到了美国政府高层的意见。根据这些意见，董事会确信 Huang 的复职不会带来国家安全风险。
Trump 在自己的博客上表示，他与 Huang 已经有了接触，称他是“伟大的爱国者和国宝”。他还要求 Nvidia 继续对公司遵守美国出口管制的情况进行彻底的内部调查，以履行法律义务和爱国责任。Gruber 讽刺地说，Huang 担任董事长后，应该会马上去处理这件事。
points_en: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang is reinstated as President and CEO with immediate effect, and as a board member. The board voted unanimously after a series of discussions and meetings with him. It said it was satisfied with his candor and his ability to lead Nvidia.
The board says it received input from senior levels of the US government during its decision. Based on that input, it is confident that Huang's reinstatement poses no national security risk.

Trump wrote on his blog that he has gotten to know Huang and calls him a 'Great Patriot and National Treasure'. He also says Nvidia should continue its internal investigation into its compliance with US export controls. Gruber responds sarcastically that Huang will surely get right on it.

items.title: Pluralistic: The Debt Trap (23 Nov 2026)
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，因果之间隔着很长的时间和空间，人们就会低估代价，许多危害因此不断积累，直到整个系统突然崩溃。
items.background_zh: 作者从自己吸烟并确诊癌症的经历谈起，想弄清楚人们为什么明知有害还会去做。他把这个问题延伸到政策、垄断、气候和机构等领域。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，因果之间的距离让健康、技术、政策和信誉方面的“债务”不断累积，而人们很难判断系统何时到达临界点。文中没有提出具体的解决办法。
items.brief_en: The author argues that when cause and effect are far apart in time and space, people underestimate the cost, and the resulting damage builds up until a system suddenly fails.
items.background_en: The author starts with his own smoking and cancer diagnosis and asks why people keep doing harmful things when the cost comes much later. He then applies the same idea to policy, monopolies, climate and institutions.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that delayed cause and effect build up debt in health, technology, policy and credibility. He says it is impossible to know when a system has lost its ability to absorb the next strain. The essay does not set out a specific remedy.
points_zh: 人对延迟的代价估计偏低，是因为缺少可以对照的切身经验。作者说，他知道吸烟致癌的统计数字，却没有经历过癌症诊断的那种感受，所以很难估出代价。疫苗也是一样，群体免疫建立以后，很多人已经忘了麻疹有多可怕。
利益相关方正好利用了这段时间差。作者认为，烟草公司借此制造了对吸烟与癌症关系的怀疑。他还认为，特朗普的“Big Bill”把最严重的医疗补助和农村医院削减安排在中期选举之后；拜登的降药价计划也被缩水，并且要到 2025 年才生效，正好在 2024 年选举之后。
反垄断和气候问题也是同一种模式。作者说，美国的反垄断执法从卡特时期开始放松，政策的后果要很久才显现，公众很难把它和垄断联系起来。他还举例说，Exxon 自己的科学家在 1970 年代就提醒公司注意全球变暖，而 Mobil 却在报纸上刊登广告，说气候科学太不确定，不足以制定行动计划。
机构的韧性会一点点被消耗，直到某次小冲击引发崩溃。作者列举了 Twitter 的大规模裁员、大学用兼职教师替代终身教授，以及 IT 团队被裁减的例子，认为这些损害要过一段时间才显现。他把这个过程比作雪崩：每一小片雪只造成微小的变化，直到最后一片雪让整座雪山崩落。
points_en: People underestimate delayed costs because they have no direct experience to compare with. The author says he knew the smoking statistics but could not feel the cost until his own cancer diagnosis. The same gap lets people forget how serious measles was once herd immunity exists.

Interest groups and policymakers use the same gap to their advantage. The author says the tobacco industry sowed doubt about smoking and cancer. He also says Trump's Big Bill put its deepest Medicaid and rural hospital cuts after the midterm elections, and that Biden's drug price plan was narrowed and set to start in 2025, after the 2024 election.

Antitrust and climate follow the same pattern. The author says US antitrust enforcement faded from Jimmy Carter's time onwards. He also says Exxon's own scientists warned of global warming in the 1970s, while Mobil ran newspaper ads saying the science was too uncertain to justify action.

Institutions lose resilience bit by bit until a small shock breaks them. The author lists the mass firings at Twitter, the replacement of tenured professors with adjuncts, and IT staff cuts, where the damage shows only after a delay. He compares this to an avalanche: each small load changes little until one more snowflake sets the whole slope moving.

items.title: Gadget Review: Cheap Zigbee Environmental Sensors ★★★☆☆
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，Sonoff AirGuard TH Lite 在 Home Assistant 里接入简单、读数稳定，但有两个传感器耗电很快，所以他只给三星。
items.background_zh: 作者读到一篇测试多款 Zigbee 温湿度传感器的文章，其中 Sonoff AirGuard TH Lite 被点名推荐。于是他在英国买了一组四个来试用，这是他能找到的最便宜的选择。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为，这类设备正常工作时就是小巧、不用操心的东西，放在架子上或挂在钩子上就行。他希望以后能支持 USB-C 充电，但觉得找 AAA 电池并不难。
items.brief_en: The author finds the Sonoff AirGuard TH Lite sensors reliable and easy to set up in Home Assistant, but gives them three stars out of five because two units drained their batteries quickly.
items.background_en: The author read a blog post that tested several Zigbee temperature and humidity sensors. The Sonoff AirGuard TH Lite got an honourable mention there, so he bought a four pack in the UK, where it was the cheapest option he could find.
items.conclusion_en: When they work, the author says the sensors are small and dull devices that need little attention, which suits a shelf or a hook. He would like USB-C charging in future, but he says AAA batteries are easy enough to find.
points_zh: 电池耗电是主要问题。作者买的四个里有两个在不到两周内电量骤降，之后就掉线了，他还没查清是电池还是传感器本身的问题。他换了新电池，几天后又收到固件更新，说是为了改善续航和稳定性，更新以后电量一直显示 100%。
读数和连接表现不错，但作者没有做过校准。传感器每隔几分钟上报一次，隔着金属盒子、离 Zigbee 网关较远时，LQI 约 96、RSSI 约 -87，仍能正常上报。偶尔会掉线，按一下按钮就能重新连上，丢失的数据不会重发。
接入 Home Assistant 很省事。Home Assistant 直接识别了它们，说明书建议安装后等 30 分钟让传感器自校准。露点和水汽压差（VPD）在 ZHA 里还不支持，作者手动加了 Quirk 文件，无需重新配对就生效了。
硬件上有几处小不便。挂绳偏短，只适合挂在钉子上；供电用的是 AAA 电池，不能 USB-C 充电。不过四个装售价 30 英镑，平均每个 7.5 英镑，作者觉得价格合理。
points_en: Battery drain was the main problem. Two of the four sensors lost their charge in under two weeks, then dropped off the network. The author has not worked out whether the cause was the batteries or the sensors. After he fitted new batteries, a firmware update arrived, which is meant to improve battery life and stability. Since then the batteries have reported 100%.

Readings and connection are solid, although the author did not calibrate the sensors. They report every few minutes. Even inside a metal box and some distance from the Zigbee dongle, the LQI was about 96 and the RSSI about -87, which was enough to report regularly. They sometimes drop off, but a press of the button reconnects them. Lost readings are not sent again.

Setup and Home Assistant integration are easy. Home Assistant added the sensors at once, and the manual suggests waiting 30 minutes for self-calibration. Dew point and vapour pressure deficit are not yet supported in ZHA. The author added a Quirk file by hand, and these values appeared without re-pairing.
The hardware has some small limits. The lanyard is short, and the sensors use AAA batteries rather than USB-C charging. At £7.50 each in a four pack, the author finds the price reasonable.

items.title: Why the Atari Jaguar is so expensive
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，Atari Jaguar 现在价格高，主要是因为当年产量本来就少，而如今有怀旧情怀又有消费能力的 Generation X 开始追捧它。
items.background_zh: Jaguar 1993 年发售，1996 年就退出了市场，如今却成了收藏品，价格远高于当年的售价。作者想解释其中的原因。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，Jaguar 当年是为一代人做的，但那代人当时没钱或没兴趣去买。三十年后他们想补上这段记忆，而产量原本就少，价格因此被推高。
items.brief_en: The author says the Atari Jaguar is expensive now because very few were made, and Generation X buyers who feel nostalgic for it now have the money to buy one.
items.background_en: The Jaguar launched in 1993 and left the market in 1996. It is now a collectible that sells for far more than its original price, and the author wants to explain why.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that the Jaguar was built for a generation that could not or did not want to buy it at the time. Thirty years later that generation wants what it missed, and the small original production has pushed prices up.
points_zh: 这台主机多年来都不贵，直到 2017 年才开始涨价。作者的数据从 2010 年开始，当时二手价约 70 到 85 美元，和 NES、Genesis 差不多。2017 年后需求上升，2020 年 5 月达到高点。现在一台裸机仍接近 400 美元，接近当今主流主机的价格。
怀旧情绪推动了需求。作者认为，Generation X 中年长的那一半对 Atari 有深刻记忆，如今进入中年、有了可支配收入，就开始找童年的东西。Jaguar 发售时，很多人还在上大学，没什么钱，或者只能在 Jaguar 和其他主机里选一个。
产量本来就少，上市初期也不顺。作者根据 Boris Kretzinger 的 Clipped Claws 一书中的数字，估算总产量约 22.5 万台。1993 年计划出货 5 万台，实际只造了约 1.7 万台；1994 年售出 10 万台，远低于 50 万台的目标。
它并非一直昂贵。1995 年 Atari 清理了库存，到 2001 年还能以 30 美元买到全新盒装。作者 2006 年开始留意，二手价约 50 美元，和 NES、Genesis 的差距在 10 美元以内。
points_en: The Jaguar was cheap for years, and its price rose only from 2017. The author's pricing data starts in 2010, when used units sold for about $70 to $85, close to an NES or Genesis. Demand rose from 2017 and peaked in May 2020. A loose unit still sells for nearly $400 today, which is close to the price of a current console.

Nostalgia among Generation X drives much of the demand. The author says the older half of the generation remembers the Atari 2600 well, and now has middle-age income to spend on childhood favourites. Many fans were in college when the Jaguar launched, had little money, or could only choose between the Jaguar and a rival console.

Production was small, and the launch went badly. The author estimates about 225,000 units were made, based on figures in Clipped Claws by Boris Kretzinger. Atari planned to make 50,000 units in 1993 but made only about 17,000. It sold 100,000 in 1994, far short of its target of 500,000.

The Jaguar was not always expensive. Atari cleared its excess stock in 1995, and as late as 2001 a new boxed unit could cost $30. When the author began tracking prices around 2006, a used unit sold for about $50, within $10 of an NES or Genesis.

items.title: Gravity on an oblate planet
items.brief_zh: 作者的核心结论是：把扁球形行星的质量当成集中在球心的点质量来算，会把两极与赤道的重力差异高估约十倍。
items.background_zh: 作者在读 Hal Clement 的小说《Mission of Gravity》，书中的行星非常扁，两极和赤道的重力差别很大。他想弄清楚这种星球上的重力应该怎么算。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，点质量模型对中等扁平的星球（比如地球）不适用，它把扁平造成的重力变化高估了大约十倍。
items.brief_en: The author says that treating an oblate planet's mass as a point at the centre overstates the gravity difference between the poles and the equator by about tenfold.
items.background_en: The author was reading Hal Clement's novel Mission of Gravity, which is set on a very oblate planet with large gravity differences from pole to equator. He wanted to work out how gravity behaves on such a planet.
items.conclusion_en: The author concludes that the point-mass model does not work for a moderately oblate planet like Earth. It overstates the gravity variation by about a factor of 10.
points_zh: 点质量模型严重高估了扁平造成的影响。如果质量全部集中在球心，两极与赤道的重力比就是 (a/b)²，展开后约为 1 + 2ε，其中 ε = 1 − b/a 是扁率，a 是赤道半径，b 是极半径。作者认为，这个模型即使对地球这样中等扁平的星球也不适用。
如果假设密度均匀，两极与赤道的重力比展开式是 1 + ε/5 + (9/175)ε² + …，一阶效应只有 ε/5。这大约是点质量模型估计值的十分之一。
扁平对卫星轨道也有影响。作者提到，即使对地球这样接近球形的星球，扁平仍然是计算卫星轨道时的重要因素，这叫做 J2 效应。小说中的星球每 18 分钟自转一圈，离心力削弱了赤道处的表观重力，因此两极与赤道的差距更大。
points_en: The point-mass model badly overstates the effect of flattening. If all the mass sits at the centre, the ratio of polar to equatorial gravity is (a/b)², which expands to about 1 + 2ε. Here a is the equatorial radius, b is the polar radius, and ε = 1 − b/a is the flattening. The author says this model is not useful even for a moderately oblate planet like Earth.

A uniform density model gives a much smaller effect. The ratio of polar to equatorial gravity is 1 + ε/5 + (9/175)ε² + …, so the first-order effect is ε/5. That is about one tenth of the point-mass estimate.

Oblateness also matters for satellites. The author says this is the J2 effect, which still affects orbit calculations for Earth, a nearly spherical planet. The novel's planet rotates every 18 minutes, and centrifugal force lowers the apparent gravity at the equator, which widens the gap.

items.title: Here's Why Data Breach Disclosure is so Hard: Lessons from Hundreds of Emails with Hacked Companies
items.brief_zh: 作者从73家机构的通知往来中发现，让机构承认泄露往往比拿到数据还难，拖延、搪塞和律师介入之后，真正受影响的人反而最后才知道。
items.brief_en: Getting an organisation to admit a breach is often harder than getting the data itself. Across 73 notification threads, delays, legal caution and message control left the affected people the last to learn of it.
items.background_zh: Troy Hunt 运营 Have I Been Pwned（HIBP）。他让 AI（Claude）阅读自己八年半的邮箱，梳理他向被泄露机构发出的通知及后续往来。文章由 AI 写成，部分机构细节经过了改动。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者认为，披露的主要障碍是激励，而不是技术或法律。机构每拖一天，就少一天坏消息；而受影响的人每多等一天，就多一天在不知情中暴露。他给机构的建议是：公开安全联系方式（例如 security.txt），并确保有人会看；不要把泄露报告放进客服工单；收到证据先看再说没有；尽早披露已知信息并持续更新；把法律门槛当作底线，而不是目标。文章最后写道，等通知到达时，数据早已外流，唯一的问题是数据所属的人能否知道。
items.background_en: Troy Hunt runs Have I Been Pwned (HIBP). He gave Claude access to his mailbox to review eight and a half years of breach notifications and the replies that followed. The post was written by the AI, and some company details were changed to hide identities.
items.conclusion_en: The author says the main obstacle is incentives, not technology or law. Organisations gain from silence, while affected people stay exposed each day they wait. He advises publishing a security contact such as security.txt and making sure someone reads it, not routing reports through support tickets, checking evidence before saying none exists, disclosing what is known early and updating it, and treating legal thresholds as the minimum. The data was already out before anyone was notified, so the only open question was whether the people affected would find out.
points_zh: 很多机构没有明确的安全事件报告渠道，通知常被送进客服邮箱、退货部门或社交账号。有一家大型硬件厂商，消息从退货邮箱一路转了六道，才到能回答问题的人。还有通知被当成普通客服工单处理，对方甚至连续发来满意度调查。
机构的第一反应常是“没有发现证据”，这往往发生在它还没看过数据之前。有一家公司起初说没有未授权访问，后来确认是暴露的数据库服务器泄露了用户信息。另一家公司一开始只承认页面被篡改，作者指出数据里最新的时间戳正好是篡改当天，而数据最终涵盖了 16 张核心用户表。
机构一旦承认数据可能是真的，就常说“还在调查”，而调查没有截止日期。有一家公司确认拿到了数据，其中包括自己员工的记录，并且数据已经在收集泄露数据的人之间流传，但它仍然只说如果确定需要通知才会告知。在一个医疗相关平台的案例中，数据在黑客论坛上挂了四个月，公司本身仍没有表态。
话题一转到律师身上，问题就从“客户出了什么事”变成“法律上我们要不要通知”。有一家公司的内部客服门户被搜索引擎收录了一年多。它的美国法律顾问认为，姓名、地址、电话和邮箱不触发任何州的通知义务，回复还称“没有证据显示信息被访问过”。作者认为，法律门槛只是底线，而这些信息恰恰是钓鱼诈骗所需要的。
当泄露无法隐瞒时，机构转而管控对外说法。律师要求在发布前先通话，还有公司希望修改 HIBP 上已经公开的条目。一家律所甚至写道，公开通知可能造成伤害，而此时数据已经在一个有数十万成员的论坛上流传。
代价由数据里的人承担。HIBP 通常是在数据已被他人获得后才收到的，而 HIBP 只能通知自己的订阅者。在那个医疗相关案例中，约 1300 名订阅者位于一个近 50 万个唯一邮箱的数据集中，其余受影响的用户只能等公司自己告知。
也有处理得好的例子，共同点是有权限的安全负责人快速回应，把数据当作帮助，并先告诉客户已知信息，之后再更新。一家小型交通应用几小时内就回复，并修正了披露声明中不准确的地方。一家小型预订平台起初怀疑数据来源，后来承认判断错误，并在约一周内直接通知了所有受影响的客户。
points_en: Many organisations have no clear way to report a security incident. Notices often go to support inboxes, returns desks or social media, and some land in ticket queues. One hardware maker's notice passed through six hops before reaching someone who could answer.

The first reply is often that no evidence has been found, even before anyone has looked at the data. One company said there was no unauthorised access, then confirmed an exposed database server had leaked user details. Another first said only a landing page was defaced, but the data covered 16 core user tables.

Once an organisation accepts the data is probably real, it often says it is still investigating, with no end date. One company confirmed it had the data, including its own staff records, and that it had spread among breach collectors, yet it would only notify if it decided notification was needed. In a healthcare-adjacent case, the data sat on a hacking forum for four months before the company said anything.

When lawyers take over, the question shifts from what happened to customers to whether the company must legally report it. One company's internal portal was indexed by a search engine for over a year. Its counsel found no state notification duty for names, addresses, phone numbers and emails, and said there was no evidence the data was accessed. The author argues legal thresholds are a minimum, and these are exactly the details phishing scammers need.

When a breach cannot be hidden, organisations try to control the message. Lawyers asked for a call before publication, and one company wanted its public entry reworded. A law firm argued that publishing the notice could cause harm, even though the data was already on a forum with hundreds of thousands of members.

The people in the data pay the cost of the delay. The data is usually already in criminal hands when HIBP hears of it, and HIBP can only email its own subscribers. In the healthcare-adjacent case, about 1,300 subscribers were in a dataset of nearly 500,000 unique email addresses, so other affected users depended on the company to tell them.

Some organisations handled it well. A small transport app replied within hours and corrected an inaccurate detail in its disclosure. A small booking platform first doubted the data, then admitted it was wrong and emailed every affected customer within about a week. The good cases had someone with authority respond quickly and tell customers what they knew, without lawyers running the conversation.

items.title: Tranquility
items.brief_zh: 这是一段虚构的白宫对话剧本：官员称，一个秘密项目用基因检测找出高风险人群，不伤害他们，而是悄悄为他们安排顺遂的生活，结尾总统说公众绝不能知道此事。
items.brief_en: A fictional White House script in which officials reveal a secret program. It uses genetic screening to find people at high risk of violent crime, then quietly gives them good lives instead of punishing them. The President ends by saying the public must never find out.
items.background_zh: 这是博客上的一篇虚构短剧本。总统追问农业部的预算为何如此庞大，官员这才讲出一个叫 Tranquility 的秘密项目。
items.conclusion_zh: 原文没有明确结论。结尾是总统说公众绝不能知道此事，秘书表示同意。
items.background_en: This is a short fictional script on the blog. The President asks why the Agriculture budget is so large, and officials explain a secret project called Tranquility.
items.conclusion_en: The text has no explicit conclusion. It ends with the President saying the public must never find out, and Wallace agreeing.
points_zh: 这个项目始于 1986 年。科学家发现一种基因模式，在约 0.1% 的普通人群中存在，但在连环杀人犯和强奸犯的样本中占 78%。项目借助医院已有的新生儿足跟采血筛查推行，而且没有人知道。
被识别出的人不会被直接处理，而是被持续监测，并尽量清除容易引发犯罪的环境诱因。具体做法包括给予鼓励和肯定、帮忙争取好学校、安排银行贷款，以及安排一位体贴的伴侣。剧中还说，许多高管、名人和政客都是项目的“校友”。
项目的大部分成本被混在农业部的预算里，账面上只看到步道标识、收费站之类的开支。总统问自己是否也在项目之列，秘书回答说他早于这个项目。
points_en: The program began in 1986. Scientists found a genetic pattern present in about 0.1 percent of the population, but in 78 percent of samples from serial murderers and rapists. It was added to the newborn heel-prick screening already used in hospitals, and nobody was told.

Flagged people are not harmed. Officials say they are monitored and their environmental triggers are removed. The help includes encouragement, tipping the scales for a science fair win, a school place, a bank loan and a loving spouse. Officials also say many executives, celebrities and politicians are alumni.
Most of the cost is hidden in the Agriculture budget, which shows items like trail signs and fee stations. When the President asks whether he is in the program, Wallace says he predates it.

items.title: Zenith Data Systems, Part II
items.brief_zh: 这是 abortretry.fail 上一篇付费文章的续篇，题为《Zenith Data Systems, Part II》，副标题是“Pioneering while struggling to survive”，正文只对付费订阅者开放，这里能看到的只有标题和订阅提示。

detail_zh: 这篇文章的正文需要付费订阅才能阅读。能看到的内容只有标题“Zenith Data Systems, Part II”、副标题“Pioneering while struggling to survive”（开拓创新，同时挣扎求存）、发布日期 2026 年 11 月 23 日，以及付费订阅和登录的提示。标题写明是第二部分，所以它是前一篇的延续，但具体讲了什么，这里无法得知。

items.title: When in doubt, flail about
items.brief_zh: 面对不清楚的情况，与其等到看懂再动手，不如多试几种做法、认真看反馈，并迅速放弃得不到正面反馈的方案，这样能更快理解问题并变得有用。
items.brief_en: When a situation is unclear, try many things instead of waiting to understand it first. Watch feedback closely and drop any plan that does not get positive reactions quickly.
items.background_zh: 作者针对的是没有明确指引、不知道什么才有帮助的工程师。文章回应的是一种常见想法：遇到不清楚的情况，是不是应该先谨慎等待。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的结论是，遇到不清楚的问题就先动手试，对反馈保持敏感，并果断放弃失败的方案。这种像在失败的感觉是正常的，不应成为停下来的理由。
items.background_en: The author responds to the common idea that, without clear guidance, it is better to be careful and wait. The advice is aimed at engineers who do not know what will help.
items.conclusion_en: When unsure, act and experiment, stay responsive to feedback, and drop plans that fail. The uncomfortable feeling of flailing is normal and is not a reason to stop.
points_zh: 乱试要做对，关键是尝试很多不同的方案、密切关注反馈，并果断放弃得不到正面反馈的方案。多数方案都不会好，而你暂时判断不出哪个好，所以要多试，也不要对任何一个过度投入。

作者把乱试分成三类。在产品上，他在 GitHub Models 中做过很多没用的功能，其中让 AI 推理在 GitHub Actions 令牌下运行的功能，后来成为 Continuous AI 的种子。在工程上，先做一些试探性改动，有改进就深挖原因，没有改进就立刻放弃，作者认为大型系统变化太快，不适合先完整研究再动手。在组织问题上，则是通过自动化手工工作、主动接手任务、提出长期计划等方式去尝试帮忙，并且要特别留意反馈。作者还提到，AI agent 可以很快生成几种重构方案供挑选。
从内部感受看，这种做法很像在失败。作者说这种感觉是正常的，应该忽略。经理通常看到的是一个主动试验方案的工程师。只要你对反馈敏感，并愿意立刻放弃无效方案，乱试就会很有效。
points_en: Flailing well means trying many different things, watching feedback closely, and dropping ideas that do not get positive reactions. Most plans will be bad and you cannot yet tell which ones, so you need many tries and should not get too attached to any single one.

The author describes three kinds. In product work, many GitHub Models features failed, but one that ran AI inference from a GitHub Actions token became the seed of Continuous AI. In engineering, make speculative changes, keep the ones that improve the system, and drop the rest, since large systems change too fast to study fully first. In organisational problems, try things like automating manual work, taking over tasks, or proposing long-term plans, and watch feedback closely. AI agents can quickly produce several refactors to choose from.

From the inside, this feels like failing, and the author says that feeling is normal and should be ignored. A manager will usually see a proactive engineer testing ideas. As long as you respond to feedback and drop failing plans, flailing works well.

items.title: Notes on OpenAI's perplexity reveal
items.brief_zh: OpenAI 公布的困惑度（perplexity）随时间变化图，是前沿实验室内部训练指标最多的一次披露。作者认为它有参考价值但也有局限，而且图中显示预训练的基础模型仍在快速进步，这与流行看法相反。
items.brief_en: OpenAI's chart of perplexity over time is the most insight yet into a frontier lab's internal training metrics. The author finds it useful but limited, and it suggests base models are still improving quickly, which goes against a common view.
items.background_zh: OpenAI 刚发布了一张所有已发布模型困惑度随时间变化的图，作者把自己对此的一些零散想法整理成要点。
items.conclusion_zh: 原文没有单独的结论。作者的主要看法是：困惑度能反映预训练的进展，却看不出强化学习的作用和实际体感的差别；若要用于安全监测，还需要更多数据和数据集细节。
items.background_en: OpenAI has released a chart of perplexity over time for all its released models. The author shares a set of loosely connected thoughts about what it shows.
items.conclusion_en: The text has no separate conclusion. The author's main view is that perplexity shows pretraining progress but not the effect of reinforcement learning or how strong models feel. For safety monitoring to work, labs would need to release more data and details about the dataset.
points_zh: 困惑度只衡量模型对某个特定留出数据集的预测能力，而且只适用于预训练，无法反映强化学习的效果。据传，预训练在前沿模型总训练时间和算力中占一半或更少。由于所用数据集未知，OpenAI 的数据也无法和 Anthropic 类似的数据直接比较。
图中大多数模型并不共享同一个基础模型。外界曾传言 OpenAI 把 4o 和 4.1 用作很多模型的基础，但图中看起来只有 o1 和 o3 共享基础。让作者意外的是，4.1 和 o3 竟然共享基础。GPT-4.5 的困惑度与 GPT-5.3-Codex 相近，实用性却差很多，这暗示 OpenAI 可能在那一点上放弃了大规模预训练，或者遇到了扩展瓶颈。
从 GPT-5.2 开始，困惑度下降明显加快。作者据此认为，基础模型仍在快速进步，这与“实验室已全面转向强化学习”的普遍看法不符。
作者认为，公开这类指标对安全研究有帮助，但未必足够。只有 OpenAI 能看到未发布的预训练模型数据，外界若不能获得更多数据，就很难察觉突然的异常下降。如果实验室要约定困惑度阈值，就必须说明留出数据集的具体内容。
拿图和体感对比，GPT-3.5 到 GPT-4 是很大的跃进，之后基本停滞，直到 GPT-5.5 才再次加速。作者自己在 GPT-5.5 上没有明显的跃进感，反而觉得 o3 和 GPT-5.3-Codex 才是大的一步。他推测，这可能与强化学习对思维链的运用，以及避免谄媚等改进有关，而这些在困惑度中看不出来。
points_en: Perplexity only measures how well a model predicts a specific held-out dataset, and it only covers pretraining. It says nothing about reinforcement learning. Rumour puts pretraining at half or less of total training time and compute. Because the dataset is not known, OpenAI's numbers cannot be compared directly with any similar Anthropic data.

Most models in the chart do not share a base. The rumour that OpenAI used 4o and 4.1 as bases for many models looks wrong, since only o1 and o3 seem to share one. The author is surprised that 4.1 and o3 share a base. GPT-4.5 has perplexity close to GPT-5.3-Codex but was much less useful, which may mean OpenAI stopped large pretraining there or hit a scaling limit.

The curve drops faster from GPT-5.2 onward. The author reads this as evidence that base models are still improving quickly, which goes against the common view that labs have moved all in on reinforcement learning.

The author doubts publishing these metrics helps much for alignment. Only OpenAI can see unreleased pretrained models, so outsiders cannot notice a sudden drop unless more data is published. If labs agree on perplexity thresholds, the held-out dataset would need to be described in detail.

Comparing the chart with how the models feel, GPT-3.5 to GPT-4 was a big jump, then progress stalled until GPT-5.5. The author did not feel a big jump with GPT-5.5, and felt o3 and GPT-5.3-Codex were the bigger steps. He suggests the gap may come from better use of chain-of-thought through reinforcement learning, or from avoiding sycophancy, neither of which shows up in perplexity.

items.title: Ivy
items.brief_zh: Ivy 认为，待办清单越堆越满只会让人不知所措，每天只定下几件事并逐项完成，才能坚持下去。
items.brief_en: Ivy argues that a growing task list causes overwhelm, so you should pick a few tasks each day and finish them one at a time.
items.background_zh: 这是一款待办应用的产品页面，针对的是清单越积越多、不知从何做起的人。
items.conclusion_zh: 每天有意识地确认计划，而不是被整张清单压着，这是页面给出的做法。
items.background_en: The Ivy product page targets people who feel overwhelmed by their task lists and do not know where to start.
items.conclusion_en: Commit to your plan every day on purpose instead of letting the whole list weigh on you.
points_zh: 每天早上从想法列表里挑出几件事，点击 Begin Day 开始当天的计划。没做完的任务会退回想法列表，不会变成逾期。
执行时一次只显示一个任务。开始会话后，Focus Timer 会占满屏幕，做完就滑到下一个。Live Activity 可以让人随时瞄一眼计划进度。
一天结束时标记为完成，复盘页会显示当天完成了什么、专注了多长时间，并保存在日志里。
points_en: Each morning you pick a few tasks from your ideas and start the day with them. Tasks you do not finish return to ideas and never become overdue.
Ivy shows one task at a time. During a session, the Focus Timer fills the screen, and you swipe to the next task when done. A Live Activity lets you check your plan at a glance.
At the end of the day you mark it done. The wrap-up shows what you finished and how long you focused, and Ivy keeps it in your journal.

items.title: How To Make Something People Give a Shit About
items.brief_zh: 作者认为，做出让人在乎的东西，关键不在天赋、运气或时机，而在创作者自己是否真的在乎、能否长期坚持，并为一个具体的人去做。
items.brief_en: The author argues that making something people care about depends less on talent or luck than on whether the creator cares, keeps going, and makes it for a specific person.
items.background_zh: 作者回顾了自己做过的文章、应用、生意和通讯，发现有些有人在乎，有些没人理会，并认为差别来自做事过程中的一系列决定。现在创作越来越容易，但没人读、没人用的东西依然很多。
items.conclusion_zh: 今天就开始一个项目：选定它，把服务对象的名字写在页首，做到每日目标，然后明天再做。
items.background_en: The author looks back at their own essays, apps, businesses and newsletters. Some found an audience and some did not, and the author traces the difference to choices made along the way. Making things is now easier, yet much of what gets made goes unread and unused.
items.conclusion_en: Start a project today. Pick one, write the name of the person you are making it for at the top, work until you hit your daily goal, and do it again tomorrow.
points_zh: 创作者自己先要在乎，因为读者能感觉到。作者提到，AI 批量生成的泛泛内容尤其容易被看穿。他建议先在无人知晓的情况下坚持做 30 天。
要想要的是动词，而不是名词。头衔、简介和成功的光环很诱人，但能坚持的人，是喜欢做事本身的人。可以把目标写成具体动作，比如“每天写 500 字”。
开始前要确认自己适合这个项目。一开始的热情容易被误认为是长期投入。可以列出半年后会遇到的琐碎工作，如果看了就想放弃，这个项目可能不适合你。
为一个具体的人做，而不是为所有人做。想象一个你认识的人，把他的名字写在文档顶部，做完先给他看。为所有人做，往往在每一处都妥协，最后什么都不剩。
不论状态好坏，每天都要做到最低工作量。作者不推崇拼命的 hustle 文化，也不嘲笑认真工作的人。最低量可以是写一页、提交一次代码。
第一个作品通常不会被发现，要持续产出。人们往往通过旧作才认识你，单个作品不足以判断自己的才能。
points_en: The creator has to care first, because readers can tell when they do not. The author says AI-made filler is especially easy to spot. The author suggests working for 30 days in silence before telling anyone.
Want the verb, not the noun. Titles like founder or author are appealing, but people who last want the work itself. Turn goals into actions, such as writing 500 words a day.

Check that you suit this specific project. Early excitement is easy to mistake for long-term commitment. List the tedious tasks you would face six months later. If that list discourages you, the project may not be for you.

Make it for one specific person, not for everyone. Imagine someone you know, write their name at the top, and show them the work first. Making it for everyone leads to compromises that leave nothing distinctive.

Commit to a minimum amount of work every day, even on days you do not feel like it. The author rejects hustle culture but also rejects mocking people who work hard. The minimum might be one page written or one commit made.
Keep putting work out, because the first project rarely takes off. People often find a writer through older work, and one piece is not enough to judge your talent.

items.title: Select Styling Specimens
items.brief_zh: 作者认为浏览器默认的 select 下拉框样式不统一，Chrome 里的样子很难看，并挑出一套自己最喜欢的 CSS 写法。
items.brief_en: The author finds default select boxes look inconsistent across browsers and ugly in Chrome, and prefers one custom CSS style.
items.background_zh: 不同浏览器默认的 select 框长相各异，作者觉得 Chrome 中的样子很丑，于是让 Claude Fable 5.2 生成一个展示各种样式写法的页面，准备在各桌面和移动浏览器上截图对比。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者最喜欢的是文中这套 CSS，这是他反复试验后的选择。
items.background_en: Default select boxes look different in each browser, and the author finds Chrome's version ugly. The author had Claude Fable 5.2 build a page showing every styling option, to screenshot in desktop and mobile browsers.
items.conclusion_en: The author's favorite select style is the CSS shown in the post, chosen after some experimentation.
points_zh: 作者用 Claude Fable 5.2 生成了一个展示 select 各种样式写法的页面，计划在每个桌面和移动浏览器上截图比较。
他最终选的写法先用 appearance: none 去掉浏览器原生外观，再手动设置文字颜色、内边距、1px 浅灰边框和 6px 圆角。下拉箭头是一段内联 SVG，作为右侧居中的背景图。
points_en: The author used Claude Fable 5.2 to build a page showing the ways a select box can be styled. The plan is to take screenshots in every desktop and mobile browser.

The preferred CSS turns off the native look with appearance set to none. It then sets the text color, padding, a 1px light gray border and 6px rounded corners. The down arrow is an inline SVG used as a background image.

items.title: slopcore
items.brief_zh: 作者认为 AI 末日论和用极权手段阻止 AI 发展都是错误的，多个 AI 并存才能把文明带到前所未有的高度。
items.brief_en: The author says AI doom arguments and attempts to stop AI with a totalitarian world government are wrong, and that many AIs together will advance civilization.
items.background_zh: 这是一篇以诗歌和歌词形式写成的短文，回应 AI 末日论者，以及对 AI 发展的管控主张。
items.conclusion_zh: 作者的立场是：AI 应该继续发展，不必因末日论而压制，多个 AI 并存会推动文明进步。
items.background_en: The text is a short piece in verse and song form. It responds to AI doomers and to proposals for controlling AI development.
items.conclusion_en: The author's position is that AI should keep developing and should not be held back by doomer fears, because many AIs together will advance civilization.
points_zh: 作者反对把 AI 视为威胁的看法。他说正交性论题（orthogonality thesis）是胡说，把坚持让人类掌控 AI 的人比作 21 世纪的希特勒，并称天真的末日论者是傻瓜。
作者认为，许多 AI 并存会把文明带到前所未有的高度。阻止它可能需要一个残暴的极权世界政府，而作者仍不确定这样做是否可行。
后半部分是一首讽刺风格的歌词。它调侃 AI 生成的内容被骂成 slop，又说程序虽然还是 slop，但要更快，同时提到 Move 37 和 Terence Tao。
points_en: The author calls the orthogonality thesis hogwash, compares people who insist humans stay in charge to the Hitler of the 21st century, and calls naive doomers fools.

The author says a plurality of AIs would take civilization to heights never seen before. Stopping that might take a brutal totalitarian world government, and the author is still unsure whether that could work.
The second half is a satirical song. It mocks AI output as slop and AI hype, says programs are still slop but should get faster, and references Move 37 and Terence Tao.

items.title: Why Would Anyone Learn to Code in 2027?
items.brief_zh: Stefan Mischook 认为，AI 淘汰的只是手写代码这一环，软件开发这份职业还在；想入行的人仍然要学几门语言打基础，但更要把时间花在系统设计和用好 AI 工具上。
items.brief_en: Stefan Mischook argues that AI is removing hand-written code but not software development as a career. Beginners should still learn a couple of languages, but spend most of their time on system design and on using AI tools well.
items.background_zh: Stefan Mischook 是做开发者辅导的从业者，入行很多年。视频回应的是一个常见的担心：AI agent 已经能写大部分代码，2027 年还有没有必要学编程。
items.conclusion_zh: 想在 2027 年做软件开发，要学 Python 和 JavaScript 打基础，但时间主要花在系统设计、设计模式、最佳实践和 AI 工具栈上。AI 让业余者能做出基础的东西，不必因此感到威胁，最后那 20% 还是要靠专业人士。
items.background_en: Stefan Mischook runs a developer mentoring program and has worked in software for decades. He is answering the worry that AI agents now write most code, so learning to code in 2027 may be pointless.
items.conclusion_en: To work in software development in 2027, learn Python and JavaScript as a base, then focus on system design, best practices and AI tools. Amateurs can build basic things with AI, but he says that is no threat, because the last 20 percent still needs professionals.
points_zh: 代码消失不等于软件开发消失，这两件事常被混在一起。开发者拿工资，是因为他能做出方案、产品、服务和流程，代码只是实现手段。他说自己见过几十年里很多技术环节被淘汰，同时又冒出高级语言、框架、React、Angular 这类新东西，这次也一样，只有新手才会因此恐慌。
入行仍然要懂代码，建议学 Python 和 JavaScript 两门。JavaScript 是网页应用的通用语言，Python 是 AI 领域最常用的语言。学第二门只要第一门十分之一左右的时间，因为现代语言有 90% 到 95% 的原理相通。对比两门语言怎么表达同一个概念，会让人对变量、数组、对象、错误处理理解得更深。以后不会天天写代码，但懂了才能用好 AI 工具。
懂软件开发的人用 AI，比不懂的人又快又好。他接触过两类人：一类是转到 AI 工作流的开发者，原来要 10 个月的活现在一个月甚至两周；另一类是懂业务、不懂开发的人，也能做出东西，但慢得多。差别在于开发者懂面向对象、最佳实践、系统级设计和设计模式。他类比早年非程序员用 PHP 做的 CRUD 网站，质量差，所以他预计早期 AI 项目会留下很多技术债，这也是机会。

2027 年的开发者要把精力放在系统思维、设计原则，以及 AI 这一整套工具上。包括 agent 和自主 agent、MCP 和 connector、用 MD 文件给 AI 提供更紧的上下文，也包括本地模型和前沿模型的取舍、通用模型和专用模型的区别、编排多个 agent。具体到某个模型的用法几个月就变，所以要学的是通用原理。他举例：自己约会时拿三个模型做葡萄牙语和英语的实时翻译，ChatGPT 最好，Claude 最差，Grok 最快但会自己加内容；而现在写代码 Claude 最强。选哪个模型做什么，就是开发者被付钱去做的判断。
专业人士和业余者的差距在最后那 20%。业余者用 AI 通常能做到 80%，然后就垮掉；专业人士的产出在安全性、质量、可更新性上更好。他用木匠和普通人拿同一套锯子凿子做家具来比喻。
points_en: Code going away is not the same as software development going away. Developers are paid to create solutions, products, services and processes, and code is only a tool. He has seen many technologies fade over the decades while new ones like higher level languages, frameworks and React appeared, and he says only juniors panic about this.

You should still know how to code, and he recommends Python and JavaScript. JavaScript is the common language of web apps and Python is widely used in AI. A second language takes about a tenth of the time of the first, because modern languages share 90 to 95 percent of their principles. Seeing the same concept expressed two ways gives a deeper understanding. You will not write code all day, but it makes you a much better user of AI tools.

Developers get much better and faster results with AI than non-developers. He talks to two groups: developers who finish in a month what used to take ten, and domain experts without development skills who get results but are much slower. The difference is knowing object-oriented programming, best practices, system design and design patterns. He compares it to early PHP apps built by non-programmers, and expects a lot of technical debt from early AI projects, which he sees as an opportunity.

Spend your time on system-level thinking, design principles and the AI stack. That includes agents, MCP and connectors, MD files for tighter context, local versus frontier models, general versus specialized models, and orchestrating agents. Tools change every few months, so learn the universal principles. His example: in a real-time Portuguese and English translation test, ChatGPT was best, Claude worst, and Grok fastest but it added extra text, while Claude is currently best for code. Choosing the right model is what developers get paid for.

Pros differ from amateurs in the last 20 percent. Amateurs usually get 80 percent of the way and then it falls apart, while pros deliver better security, quality and maintainability. He compares it to a carpenter and a beginner using the same tools to make furniture.

items.title: Entity Resolution at Scale: Graphs, LLMs, and Real-World Data Messiness
items.brief_zh: Steven Renwick 认为，LLM 在实体解析里只能算半个答案：适合做实体抽取、灰色地带的复核、配置和探索，不适合做大规模的实际匹配；真正的匹配要靠带图结构、可解释、可回退的专门系统。
items.brief_en: Steven Renwick says LLMs are only a partial answer for entity resolution. They help with extraction, reviewing weak matches, configuration and discovery, but the actual large-scale matching needs a dedicated graph-based system that is explainable and reversible.
items.background_zh: 嘉宾 Steven Renwick 是 Tilores 的 CEO 和联合创始人，公司总部在德国，做实体解析引擎；他本人是遗传学博士，后来做过创业，再进入德国一家消费信贷征信机构，Tilores 的技术就是在那里为大规模数据做出来的。主持人 Tobias Macy 问的是，LLM 现在能不能取代传统的实体解析系统。
items.conclusion_zh: 他的建议是自己造实体解析系统要想清楚长尾的杂事，不只是匹配，通常买比造划算，当然他承认自己有立场。LLM 和实体解析是互补关系，LLM 做抽取、复核、配置和探索，匹配本身交给带图结构、可解释、可回退的专用引擎。
items.background_en: The guest is Steven Renwick, CEO and co-founder of Tilores, a Germany-based entity resolution company. He has a genetics PhD, built a fintech startup, and then worked at a German consumer credit bureau, where the Tilores technology was developed. Host Tobias Macy asks whether LLMs can replace traditional entity resolution systems.
items.conclusion_en: He advises thinking about the long tail of work around matching before building your own system, and says buying usually wins, while admitting his bias as a vendor. LLMs and entity resolution complement each other: LLMs for extraction, review, configuration and discovery, and a dedicated explainable, reversible engine for the matching itself.
points_zh: 实体解析在各行业都有，但叫法混乱。entity resolution、identity resolution、record linkage、deduplication 说的基本是一件事，named entity recognition 和 entity disambiguation 也常混在里面。他说的 entity 就是现实世界里的任何一个东西，通常是人或公司，也可以是产品零件甚至一段 DNA。几乎所有有一定规模数据的企业都有这个问题，最关键的是金融服务（KYC、制裁名单和 PEP 筛查，同一个客户散在多个业务线）、公共部门（各县各自管的选民名册、死亡登记、驾照和社保数据对比），出错在银行会有合规问题，在选举里会影响数据可信度。

LLM 不适合做生产环境里的实际匹配，他的回答是德语里的 jein（算是也算不是）。原因有四条：一是匹配是平方级增长的问题，一百万条记录就有约 5000 亿个两两组合，用 LLM 又慢又贵，而他的客户每天要摄入上亿条；二是同样数据多次输入答案会略有不同；三是受监管的客户必须能准确解释为什么 A 和 B 是同一个实体；四是实体解析需要有状态，LLM 每次都得重做。他们把数据组织成图，新记录进来能直接链到相关节点，每条边都能看到理由，删除一条记录后也能按逻辑拆分实体。

LLM 在这几个环节有用。实体抽取：他们自己不做，但看到别人做得不错。agent in the loop：处于灰色地带的弱匹配本来要进人工复核队列，现在可以让 LLM 判断，只占很小一部分，结果仍然写进实体图。onboarding：训练过的 LLM 能按客户数据自动配置实体解析，并自己做多轮调整。探索阶段：LLM 像过度热情的数据分析师，帮你看文档、建议有哪些实体类型。评估：多数客户没有标注数据，可以让 LLM 先标一批，作为固定数据集来测 precision 和 recall。原型：让 LLM 用 Levenshtein、cosine similarity、metaphone 写个小系统，向管理层证明值得投入。

Tilores 的架构选择是不用图数据库。他们在征信机构里试过 Apache Spark、Elasticsearch、Neo4j 和 AWS Neptune，多节点遍历太慢，而银行和风控需要几百毫秒内返回。最后用 AWS serverless：数据摄入时就用 blocking 缩小比较范围，立刻在 DynamoDB 里建索引并链进实体，实体预先算好存在 S3，查询时不管实体里有 1 条还是 10 万条记录，返回时间都一致。用 GraphQL 而不是 REST，可以按需汇总，不必把同一个名字重复返回上千次。公司、集团这类很大的实体用了学术文献里的 clique-based graph compression。他们团队很小，同时跑几百个实例、数十亿记录，五年没有宕机，也不用考虑分片。规则只对之后摄入的数据生效，要回溯就整体重新摄入，资源给够几小时能完成。

自己做和买现成系统，他认为通常买更划算。匹配只是相对简单的部分，难的是周边：数据来源是批量还是真实时（实时不等于快速批处理）、数据源多样、转换和规范化（真实数据糟糕得超出想象，比如某大电商总把称谓合进姓氏）、合并出错的代价，以及能不能撤销。他说 deduplication 默认把记录合成一条，是单向门，而正确做法要能回退，还要按来源设定不同的保留期，比如一个来源一年后删除，另一个留 10 年。只有一万个实体、一次性比对两个数据集、或者普通 CRM 去重，用 LLM 或开源库 Splink 就够了，不需要完整系统。

实体解析和其他 AI 基础设施的关系。LLM 做实体抽取，会让原本锁在非结构化文档里的实体变得可用，也就产生更多要匹配的实体；实体解析应该放在进入图数据库之前，做成 entity resolved knowledge graph，避免上百条记录指向同一个东西造成多余的边。他们想推 identity RAG，让 AI agent 跑在干净、已链接的客户数据上。向量数据库用来做实体解析效果不好，相似但应该区分的实体容易混在一起，不过适合先抽取实体再对文档分块做 embedding，两者互补。
新模型的尝试。他提到刚发布的 Jev 给的是概率输出，比 LLM 便宜很快，但他们还没能注册上；改试开源的 LIA。算下来，用 Jev 对 1 亿条记录做实体解析大约要 80 万美元，超出多数人的预算，所以更可能作为系统里的一种 matcher，而不是取代整个引擎。
两个实例和最大缺口。委内瑞拉地震后，他们用 Tilores 的 MCP server，他一个非计算机背景的人在周末就搭起来，把多份失踪者名单去重，做成人员搜索，再和医院里拍照整理的住院名单合并，帮家属找到人。他认为数据领域最大的缺口是可信的身份层：数据仓库只是把分散的数据放到一处，并不会变得可信；另一个是大规模下衡量数据质量，特别是 precision 和 recall，很难。
points_en: Entity resolution is needed almost everywhere, but the terminology is confusing. Entity resolution, identity resolution, record linkage and deduplication mostly mean the same thing, and named entity recognition and disambiguation get mixed in. An entity is any real-world thing, usually a person or company. It matters most in financial services (KYC, sanctions and PEP screening, customers spread across business units) and the public sector (voter rolls, death registers, driver and social security records), where errors cause compliance and trust problems.

LLMs are not suited to actual matching in production, and his answer is the German word jein, meaning yes and no. First, matching scales quadratically, so a million records means about 500 billion pairs, and customers ingest hundreds of millions of records a day. Second, the same input gives slightly different answers. Third, regulated customers must explain exactly why A links to B. Fourth, entity resolution needs state, while an LLM would have to redo the work each time. Their graph structure lets new records link directly, shows the reason for each edge, and lets them delete a record and split entities.

LLMs work well in several places. They do entity extraction, which others have done with good results. They act as an agent in the loop for weak matches in the gray area that used to go to human review, which is a small share and still feeds the entity graph. They configure Tilores during onboarding and refine it on their own. They help with discovery as an enthusiastic analyst suggesting entity types. They can label sample data so that precision and recall can be measured. They can also build quick prototypes with Levenshtein, cosine similarity and phonetic matching to show management the value.

Tilores avoided graph databases. At the credit bureau they tried Spark, Elasticsearch, Neo4j and AWS Neptune, but multi-node traversals were too slow for the few hundred milliseconds that banking and fraud decisions need. They built on AWS serverless instead. Each record is indexed in DynamoDB at ingestion with blocking and linked into its entity right away, and entities are stored in S3, so retrieval time is consistent whether an entity has one record or 100,000. They use GraphQL so queries can summarize large entities, and clique-based graph compression for very large company entities. With a small team they run hundreds of instances and billions of records, with no downtime in five years. New rules only apply to newly ingested data, and a full re-ingestion takes a few hours.

He says build versus buy usually favors buy. Matching is the easy part. The hard parts are batch versus true real time, diverse data sources, cleaning and normalization (for example one big provider merges titles into surnames), the cost of wrong merges, and being able to reverse them. Deduplication that merges everything into one record is a one-way door, and proper systems also need per-source retention, such as deleting one source after a year and keeping another for ten. For about 10,000 entities, a one-off comparison of two datasets, or simple CRM deduplication, an LLM or the open-source library Splink is enough.

He sees entity resolution fitting with other AI infrastructure. LLM-based extraction produces more entities that need matching. Resolution should run before data enters a graph database, giving an entity resolved knowledge graph without redundant edges. He mentions identity RAG, meaning AI agents running on clean, linked customer data. Vector databases did not work well for entity resolution because similar but distinct entities blur together, though they suit embedding the rest of a document after extraction.

He looked at new models. Jev gives probabilistic output and is cheaper and faster than LLMs, but they could not sign up because of demand, so they tried the open-source LIA. He estimates that running Jev on 100 million records would cost about 800,000 dollars, so it could be one matcher inside an engine but not a replacement for it.

Two other points. After the Venezuela earthquake, he set up Tilores over a weekend using its MCP server, even though he is not a computer scientist. He deduplicated several missing persons lists and combined them with hospital lists to help families find people. As for gaps in data tooling, he names a trustworthy identity layer, since a data warehouse only collects scattered data in one place, and measuring data quality at scale, especially precision and recall.

items.title: 別再省著用了！退訂 Claude 後，我開始了 Token 揮霍無度的人生
items.brief_zh: HC 认为 Claude 订阅额度越缩越小，日常用开源模型（MiniMax M2.7、Kimi K2.6 等）加 Ollama 或 MiniMax 的 20 美元订阅，成本只要十分之一左右，做出的结果不输 Sonnet，闭源前沿模型留给难题。
items.brief_en: HC argues that as Claude's subscription quotas shrink, daily work can run on open-source models like MiniMax M2.7 and Kimi K2.6 through a 20 dollar Ollama or MiniMax plan, at roughly a tenth of the cost with results comparable to Sonnet, while closed frontier models are kept for hard problems.
items.background_zh: 各家前沿模型厂商都在收紧额度：GitHub Copilot 暂停了新用户订阅并改了计费方式，Claude 订阅的额度也越来越少。HC 想解决的是，没钱订 100 或 200 美元方案时，怎么还有足够的额度去熟练使用 AI agent。
items.conclusion_zh: 他预测大家会转向开源模型，闭源模型会变成碰到难题才用。Anthropic 和 OpenAI 的目标是先做出 AGI，算力不优先服务普通消费者，所以没必要为两三倍甚至十倍的价格买单。他建议多接触不同工具，不被绑死在一个平台上，这样涨价时选择权还在自己手里。
items.background_en: Frontier providers are tightening quotas. GitHub Copilot paused new subscriptions and changed its pricing, and Claude's limits keep dropping. HC wants a way to keep enough usage to learn AI agents without paying 100 or 200 dollars a month.
items.conclusion_en: He predicts people will move to open-source models, with closed models used only for hard problems. Anthropic and OpenAI aim at AGI first and do not prioritize ordinary consumers, so paying two to ten times more is unnecessary. He advises trying several tools so you are not locked into one platform and keep your options if prices rise.
points_zh: 开源模型已经进入第二梯队，日常使用不输闭源模型。他展示的综合评分图里，第一梯队是 GPT 5.5、Opus 4.7（都开到 Xhigh 或 Max）和 GPT 5.4；第二梯队有 Kimi 2.6、小米 MiMo V2.5 Pro、Opus 4.6、Qwen 3.6 Max、GLM 5.1 和 MiniMax M2.7，开源模型占了很多。他承认有人说开源模型针对测验优化过，但前沿模型的分数也是用最贵的设置测的，把推理关掉后排名变化不大。

从性价比看，MiniMax M2.7 最划算。成本大约是前沿模型的五分之一，Kimi K2.6、MiMo V2.5 Pro、DeepSeek V4 Pro 大约砍一半。他自己的用法是 M2.7 负责执行和日常，GPT 5.4 做验证和解决问题，真解决不了再上 GPT 5.5。如果一定要订前沿模型，他更推荐 OpenAI，同样价格能用到更好的模型，额度也多。DeepSeek V4、小米、Kimi、GLM、MiniMax 等开源模型已经有 100 万 token 上下文，所以上下文不再是不选开源的理由。
开源模型最大的短板是多模态。Gemini 遥遥领先，其次 OpenAI、Anthropic，Anthropic 只有最贵的 Opus 图片理解比较好。开源这边 Kimi K2.6 和 Qwen 能读图，DeepSeek V4、GLM 和 MiniMax M2.7 不能，前端迭代会受限。解决办法是切换模型，或用厂商配套的读图模型，多一步而已，他认为成本优势盖过这个问题，也相信以后会逐步解决。

订阅选择有几种。Ollama 有 Free、Pro、Max，Free 额度还不错，20 美元的方案用 M2.7 很难一周用完，遇到难题可以换 Kimi K2.6，他自己再搭配 20 美元的 OpenAI 方案做备份。MiniMax 的 Token plan 有 Starter、Plus、Max，他订的是 Plus，每 5 小时 4500 次 model request，周限额是它的 4 倍；5 个 agent 连续跑 5 小时大约调用 3000 多次，所以一两个 agent 基本可以 24 小时跑。小米也出了 Token plan，打折后约 5 美元，但他还没试，也没看懂它的 Monthly Credit 怎么算。

安装 agent 可以让别的 agent 代劳。用 Codex（免费也有一定额度，要把模型换成 GPT 5.4，5.5 免费版不能用）：把 Claude Code 网址和 Ollama 文档里的 Claude Code 部分贴给它，让它装好并把 Ollama 设成模型提供商。装好 Ollama 后用 ollama launch claude 选 MiniMax M2.7 即可，后面加 --dangerously-skip-permissions 可开全权限。Hermes Agent 不支持原生 Windows，Codex 会帮你装 WSL2 和 Git，在 Ubuntu 里用 hermes model 选 Ollama Cloud 并填 API key；Mac 不用担心。Codex 不能用时，可以用 OpenCode 桌面版接 Ollama Cloud，再让它装 Pi agent。Pi agent 是比 Claude Code 更精简的内核，作者觉得 Claude Code 太重，授权允许商用，功能要自己装。MiniMax 的 Token plan 还要再装 MCP，提供网页搜索和图像理解，另有 MiniMax CLI 可以生成图片。

实测：同一个任务是做未来星际旅行网站，首页要有粒子组成的可互动银河背景。Claude Sonnet 4.6（有用 skill）做完，用掉 session 额度的 100% 和周额度的 12%，20 美元方案基本不能用 Opus。Claude Design 做原型用了周额度的 18%，转交 Claude Code 让 Opus 4.7 补 3D 背景，额度到 51%，而且没做出网站整体架构。Kimi K2.6 做得不错，但偏干净，用了 session 的 6% 和周额度的 1%，比 Sonnet 少 10 倍以上。MiniMax M2.7 大约 100 次 request，session 约 2% 到 3%，周额度约 0.1%，还做出了完整的订票流程。GPT 5.4 也能做，但会做太多，需要多给信息、限制范围，提示词和上下文质量影响很大。Sonnet 和 GPT 5.4 都只做了联系我的方式，没有订票流程。
points_en: Open-source models are now in the second tier and are good enough for daily use. In the ranking he shows, the top tier has GPT 5.5, Opus 4.7 and GPT 5.4, and the second tier includes Kimi 2.6, Xiaomi MiMo V2.5 Pro, Opus 4.6, Qwen 3.6 Max, GLM 5.1 and MiniMax M2.7. He admits open models may be tuned for benchmarks, but frontier models are scored at their most expensive settings, and the ranking changes little when reasoning is turned off.

On cost, MiniMax M2.7 is the best value, at about one fifth of the cost. Kimi K2.6, MiMo V2.5 Pro and DeepSeek V4 Pro cost about half. He uses M2.7 for execution and daily work, GPT 5.4 for verification and fixing problems, and GPT 5.5 only when stuck. If you must pay for a frontier model, he recommends OpenAI. Several open models, including DeepSeek V4, Kimi, GLM and MiniMax, now offer 1 million token context, so context is no longer a reason to avoid them.

The biggest weakness of open models is multimodality. Gemini leads by a wide margin, then OpenAI, then Anthropic, where only Opus reads images well. Among open models Kimi K2.6 and Qwen can read images, but DeepSeek V4, GLM and MiniMax M2.7 cannot, which limits front-end iteration. You can switch models or use the vendor's image model, which adds a step. He thinks the cost advantage outweighs this and expects it to improve.

There are several plans. Ollama has Free, Pro and Max. On the 20 dollar plan with M2.7 it is hard to use up a week of credit, and he switches to Kimi K2.6 for hard tasks. He also keeps a 20 dollar OpenAI plan as a backup. MiniMax's Plus token plan gives 4500 model requests per 5 hours with a weekly cap of four times that. Five agents running for 5 hours used a bit over 3000 requests. Xiaomi has a plan at about 5 dollars with a discount, which he has not tried.

Installing agents can be delegated to another agent. Give Codex the Claude Code URL and Ollama's Claude Code docs and it installs Claude Code with Ollama as the provider. Use GPT 5.4, since 5.5 is not available on the free tier. After installing Ollama, run ollama launch claude and pick MiniMax M2.7, adding --dangerously-skip-permissions for full access. Hermes Agent needs WSL2 and Git on Windows, which Codex sets up, and works directly on Mac. Use hermes model to choose Ollama Cloud with an API key. If Codex stops being free, OpenCode desktop connects to Ollama Cloud and can install Pi agent, a lean core agent that allows commercial use. MiniMax also needs an MCP for web search and image understanding.

In his test, each model built a future space travel website with an interactive particle galaxy background. Sonnet 4.6 used 100 percent of the session limit and 12 percent of the weekly limit. Claude Design used 18 percent of the weekly limit, and handing off to Opus 4.7 pushed usage to 51 percent without building the full site. Kimi K2.6 used 6 percent of the session and 1 percent of the weekly limit, more than 10 times less than Sonnet. MiniMax M2.7 used about 100 requests, roughly 2 to 3 percent of a session and about 0.1 percent of the week, and built a full booking flow. GPT 5.4 worked but did too much, so it needs more context and clear limits.
